stage: After initial graph/cache observations and before fair shared-cache timing measurements. All original samples/transitions retained.
reason: Fresh per-anchor parsing inflates the full-rebuild baseline by denying same-version reuse available to the persistent path. Keep it as a diagnostic, not the main performance comparison.
main_timing_phases: full_after_shared: one fresh in-memory AST cache for all 30 current-version anchor queries
incremental_after: before-version ASTs already loaded; same 30 current-version queries, persistent writes for newly parsed modules included
warm_stable_after: same persistent cache and the same 30 current-version queries again
excluded_costs: Source mappings are verified and loaded before timing. Untimed before-AST cache priming represents prior evidence capture. File reads/hash cost and Git object transport are not measured.
assertions: Every graph from every phase must be byte-identical to its original full rebuild, including frontier and metadata. Preserve original diagnostics; report small, zero, or negative effects without selective exclusions.
delivery_revision: The initial renderer was developed into a compact source-first renderer after observing budget failures. Preserve initial results and reconstructed initial source, replay its original metrics, then replay compact delivery on identical graph IDs. No held-out efficacy claim.
